savedTaskHistoryNotice: Saved execution results and events; interrupted tasks will not rerun automatically.
browserEvidenceDisplayLimit: The browser displays up to 2000 entries; the complete evidence is retained on disk.
backendControlledOperations: Controlled operations this backend can request
toolCatalogExecutionDisclaimer: The catalog lists registered capabilities. Actual execution remains subject to project scope, permissions, human confirmation, and frontend receipts. A tool listing does not mean the model executed it successfully; rely on the actual receipts.
toolCatalogUnavailable: The tool catalog has not loaded yet. Please reopen it later.
codexLoginMcpHelp: Reuse your existing Codex login to invoke the app's registered controlled operations through a separate MCP session. No additional API Key is needed. The original novel workflow remains independent.
declaredToolSupportTestFirst: The model settings declare tool support. Test the service first. Tool failures are reported accurately and are not retried automatically.
unknownOrUnsupportedToolsNotice: Tool capability UNKNOWN / unsupported: provides Q&A and suggestions only, without performing software operations.
highRiskAndCharacterDraftSafeguards: High-risk operations always require human confirmation. Character drafts enter Proposal and do not automatically modify Canon, State, or Final.
assistantContextPrivacyHelp: Permissions take effect on the next send. The full book, all secrets, and disk directories are not sent by default. Writing style material is filtered by the original Writer-safe workflow. Operation summaries do not store complete private instructions.
capabilitiesAndRestrictions: What it can and cannot do
assistantSupportedOperationsDescription: Find and open chapters, characters, and references; change themes and font sizes; create drafts, inspiration notes, to-dos, and separate backups; propose settings, links, and selected-text revisions.
codexOperationsScopeAndRestrictions: Codex software operations support project lists; work, chapter, and character navigation; character queries; themes; project status; character drafts; font size; line spacing; character reference panes; and settings categories. For other operations, switch to API or the original novel workflow. Standard API access does not grant arbitrary access to files, Shell, SQL, or credentials. Existing read-only Codex reviews run through the original Task Manager. Manual writing remains available without a network connection.
projectOrTaskChangedOperationCanceled: Project or task changed; interface operation canceled
fixedOperationsWaitHelp: Fixed operations can wait for 30 minutes without the model remaining online
fullBookNotSentByDefaultSuffix: · Full book not sent by default
putCurrentCharacterInReferencePane: Put the current character in the reference pane
exampleInstructionsHelp: Examples only fill the input box. Review before sending; important operations require confirmation.
draftAndInterfaceReversible: Yes (drafts can be discarded and the interface restored)
confirmationExpirySuffix: ; automatically rejected if the project or target version changes.
reenterInstructionAfterReview: Re-enter the instruction (review the executed-operation records before sending again)
operationSummaryPrivacyLabel: Operation summary (no keys or complete manuscript text)
embodied_confirmationNote: Shortcuts use local registered Actions. Review and revision requests require confirmation and never overwrite prose directly.
embodied_capabilityNote: Only assets present in this model are listed. Several task states may reuse one basic motion. Unrigged gestures are not simulated as completed.
embodied_voiceRequired: Choose a voice and enable playback first.
embodied_noReply: No model reply is available to read.
embodied_selectFirst: Save the manuscript and select a passage first.
embodied_importFields: Enter the model name and usage rights.
embodied_rights: Confirm that you have local usage rights for this model. Private models are excluded from public packages. Continue?
embodied_finishFirst: Finish or cancel the current task first.
embodied_scopeChanged: Project or assistant changed. Select the target again.
embodied_selectionPermission: Enable selected-text access in this assistant’s model and permissions first. The full chapter is not sent automatically.
embodied_asrUnavailable: Speech recognition is unavailable in this browser / WebView. Use text input.
embodied_asrConsent: Browser speech recognition may send audio to the browser vendor’s online service. Avoid private information. The transcript will only fill the input; review it before sending. Start?
embodied_queuedNotDone: Queued does not mean reviewed. Check the actual task status and report.
embodied_reportReady: Review completed. Open the saved report.
